subject_lessons.title: Y9 Math (Algebra I): Quadratic Polynomials (x²+y², xy) & Exponential Decay (γᵗ)
subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL ALGEBRA I LESSON (GRADE 9):
• Linear functions (`ax + by + c = 0`) can only draw straight lines.
• Quadratic Polynomials include second-degree terms like `x² + y²` (the equation of a circle!) and `x * y` (hyperbolas).
• Exponential Functions `f(t) = A * γ^t` decay smoothly when `0 < γ < 1`—which is the exact Bellman Discount Factor `γ^t` and PRIME Moment decay factor!

# 📐 YEAR 9 ALGEBRA I LAB: Quadratic Feature Basis & Exponential Discount

subject_lessons.subject: science
subject_lessons.title: Y9 Physics: Kinematics (v = v₀ + at), Vectors, Momentum & Mechanical Work
subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL PHYSICS LESSON (GRADE 9):
• Velocity Vector `(vx, vy)` integrates acceleration over time step `dt`:
  `vx_new = vx + ax * dt`,   `x_new = x + vx_new * dt`
• Kinetic Energy `KE = 0.5 * m * v²` grows with the SQUARE of speed—which is why doubling a lander's impact speed quadruples the crash energy!
